subject: Civil Engineering
title: Water Loss and Leakage
description: One-minute skill: Water Loss and Leakage.

hook.text: Cities lose 20-50% of treated water to leaks before it reaches a single faucet.

buildup.text: Aging pipes crack, joints separate, and corrosion creates holes — all below ground.

discovery.text: Acoustic sensors detect leaks by listening for the hiss of escaping water underground.

twist.text: Pressure management reduces leakage — lower pressure at night means fewer burst pipes.

climax.text: Singapore reduced water loss to just 5% — one of the lowest rates in the world.

punchline.text: Fix the leaks and you find water you already had — no new source needed.

quiz.question: How do acoustic sensors help reduce water loss?
options: They send ultrasonic waves to seal pipe cracks automatically
They detect the sound of water escaping from underground leaks
They measure water flow speed to identify low-pressure zones
